title: DOJ probes Iran’s alleged use of Binance to evade US sanctions: WSJ
summary: The Department of Justice is investigating Iran’s use of Binance for alleged sanctions evasion after the exchange repeatedly denied wrongdoing.

title: ECB reveals Appia roadmap for central bank money in Europe’s tokenized markets
summary: The European Central Bank has launched Appia to guide Europe’s tokenized financial ecosystem anchored in central bank money, with early Pontes pilots planned for 2026.

title: XRP price chart mirrors 1,500% rally setup from 2017, but there is a catch
summary: XRP's weekly chart mirrors the 2017 setup that projects a massive upward rally, but bulls must first break resistance around $2.

title: US seeks forfeiture of $3.4M in USDt tied to crypto investment scam
summary: US prosecutors moved to forfeit $3.44 million in USDt allegedly tied to a crypto investment scam that tricked victims into sending Ether to wallets controlled by fraudsters.

title: Aave wstETH glitch forces $27M in liquidations and compensation
summary: Capo, an external oracle solution used by Aave, triggered around $27 million in liquidations after a pricing glitch, but the lending platform said it is stepping in to cover the losses.

title: Bitcoin ETFs add $251M as Goldman Sachs tops XRP ETF holders
summary: US spot Bitcoin ETFs continued their March rally, with cumulative monthly inflows reaching $1.56 billion, while XRP ETF selling eased as top holders were revealed.

title: Tokenized assets climb to $23.6B as investors seek always-on markets
summary: Tokenized real-world assets have surged 66% in 2026, with funds, gold and equities driving growth across public blockchains.

title: Bitcoin faces ‘highly volatile’ setup as bulls eye return to $80K by month-end
summary: Bitcoin open interest sparked a prediction of high BTC price volatility to come as $70,000 remained the bulls' key reclaim level.

title: Brera board approves Solmate pivot, cuts soccer teams to focus on Solana
summary: Nasdaq-listed Brera plans to rebrand as Solmate, wind down two soccer teams and propose a 10-for-1 reverse stock split as it pivots toward Solana.

title: DAOs aren't doomed, they just need to evolve: Aave founder
summary: A proposal to transfer control of Aave’s brand assets and intellectual property to its DAO failed in January, prompting debate over the protocol’s long-term direction.
